name: Appraising Hand
desc: The severed and preserved hand of a once famous art merchant. Will appraise any small object placed in its grip and communicate its fair market value with gestures.

name: Aroma-Alchemy Candle
desc: When placed in or on a material with alchemical properties and lit, the essence of the material is wicked up into the candle and dispersed through the area with a decreased effect. For example if placed within a sleeping potion it would result in a smell that encourages drowsiness and keeps those already asleep from waking.

name: Blindfold of the Nightwalker
desc:
A leather blindfold with a closed eye embossed across the front.

While wearing the Blindfold light and dark are reversed to your vision. Well lit areas are pitch black and lightless rooms are clear as day.

name: Fall Feather
desc:
A slightly shimmering, but otherwise unremarkable bird feather.

While grasping the feather falling occurs as a leisurely, safe speed. Lasts until you next touch the ground. Single use. Standard safety equipment found on airships, skywhale trains, and other modes of aerial transport.

name: Greathorn Blade
desc:
A sword roughly carved from the horn of some great beast.

If pierced into the ground at a campsite, most creatures will avoid the location due to the lingering intimidating presence of the original beast.

name: Living Wood Bust
desc:
A wooden bust, apparently grown into shape rather than carved. It has only a vague suggestion of a face, rather than detailed features.

If placed on a wood, living or dead, the bust will enable that object to speak and answer three questions.

name: Lizardskin Cloak
desc:
Billowing cloak made of tanned lizard skin, scale pattern still visible. If the cloak is charged a bright yellow like a morning sun, while discharged it’s a dull blue.

While charged, can be made to glow as a dim torch. Discharge the cloak to release either:

- a bright flash which will dazzle or blind anyone looking at it.
- a lance of sunlight dealing d10 damage whose Wounds ignite the target.

Recharge by basking in sunlight while wearing it for 6 hours.

name: Magic Jam
desc:
Jar of sticky, elderberry jam.

Apply to a magic item to make it edible. Eating the item will incorporate its effects into your body in some way (results not guaranteed). 3 servings (large items may require multiple servings).

name: Seed of the Flower Of Second Blooming
desc: If planted within a corpse and tended for a season, the plant will produce a single fruit. Eating the entire fruit will grant all memories of the corpse’s life. Aspects of their personality may also bleed over.

name: Snarrow Quiver
desc:
A simple quiver made of snake leather. Contains 1d4-1 venomous snakes.

When a snake is drawn from the quiver it straightens and becomes rigid, allowing it to be fired from a bow. Direct damage applies the snake’s poison. Snakes may not survive this ordeal. New snakes may be captured and added if found. A steady diet of eggs, rodents, or other food is required to keep the snakes alive.

name: Umbral Dagger
desc:
A long, slightly curved dagger. Regardless of the ambient light, one edge of the dagger appears to be illuminated and the other is hidden in shadow.

The dagger can cut both light and shadow, allowing the user to pick up and manipulate the severed pieces as though they were fabric.

name: Clutches of Chosen Kinship
desc:
A matched pair of handbags linked to the same pocket dimension. Any number of objects that fit through the opening can be stored inside and accessed from either bag. Finding a specific item takes a few minutes.

Personality: Loyalty and friendship.

name: Grapple of Forced Perspective
desc:
Close one eye and hook the grapple onto anything you can see, regardless of distance. Mind the length of the rope.

Personality: Detached perspective.

name: Gourd of Pleasant Fullness
desc:
Regardless of how much liquid is poured into the gourd, enough of that liquid to fully satisfy all nearby drinkers pours out.

Personality: Generous host.

name: Hammer of Vigorous Obstinacy
desc:
A hammer and three spikes. An object with one of these spikes hammered into it becomes immovable and indestructible. The Resplendent Tower remains half floating after a landslide thanks to one of these spikes.

Personality: Unyielding stubbornness.

name: Torch of Mischievous Light
desc:
An ever-burning torch that especially illuminates things deliberately hidden or wishing to remain obscured.

Personality: Impish inquisitiveness.

name: Sword of Cutting Judgment
desc:
When multiple people disagree about a future action, spin the sword on the ground. It points toward the person whose proposed course is most likely to lead to violence. Can only be used once per future event.

Personality: Quick tempered.
